real_name: Azam Cheema (real name kept in film)
real_life_notes: Real Lashkar-e-Taiba (LeT) operative and one of the primary planners of the 2008 Mumbai attacks. Named in David Headley's confessions as a key 26/11 coordinator. Never prosecuted in Pakistan. Operates under ISI patronage.
film_role: Film 2 target — one of the 26/11 planners that Hamza and Rizwan are tasked to locate and neutralise under the Naya Bharat revenge arc.
objective: Continue LeT operational planning against India; maintain ISI patronage; avoid Indian intelligence targeting
real_status: As of 2024, whereabouts unclear. Never officially prosecuted in Pakistan. UNSC-listed terrorist.
